answer_1.quote: Decoding continuous language text from brain activity stands as a groundbreaking endeavor at the nexus of neuroscience, linguistics, and artificial intelligence.
answer_1.outputs: reconstructed continuous language from fMRI-based brain recordings

answer_2.quote: To evaluate the similarity of reference and prediction, various language similarity metrics are employed, including Word Error Rate (WER), BLEU-1 (BLEU), METEOR (METR), and BERTScore (BERT).
